campaign_name: IZAKHONO HOST — SME Website + Hosting + Business Email

creative.brief: Generate qualified enquiries from South African SMEs and organisations that need a professional website, reliable hosting and business email without juggling multiple suppliers.
creative.key_message: One practical business stack: professional website, hosting and business email, with IZAKHONO-owned infrastructure preferred and replaceable external resilience where needed.
hooks: Still running your business without a proper website and company email?
Website, hosting and business email in one place.
Already have a site? We can improve the conversion journey instead of rebuilding blindly.
compliance_notes: Do not claim zero downtime or guaranteed rankings.
Do not claim owned public infrastructure is live where it has not been independently verified.
Confirm scope, domain, mailbox count, content and migration requirements before final quotation.

offer: Professional business website + hosting + business email, or a conversion-improvement pilot for companies that already have a website.
